title: Code: testing an ecological security pattern in Mizoram, India
description: Code that produces the results of the article Testing an ecological security pattern against independent species records in a shifting-cultivation mountain of the Indo-Burma hotspot (Khiangte, Sati and Khuma, under review): the pooled, terrain-corrected Remote Sensing Ecological Index (RSEI) for 35 dry seasons (1990–2025), trend and driver analyses, guild-specific connectivity models (least-cost corridors, Circuitscape and Omniscape), validation with independent species records, and the ecological security pattern (ESP) with restoration scenarios. Mizoram, north-east India.
